title: DuplexTune: Coupled-State Replay for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse expert execution does not remove the stored states needed to adapt a mixture-of-experts language model. We present DuplexTune, a framework for replaying coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules. Trainable width bridges connect two residual streams to the backbone. Bridge warm-up precedes backbone adaptation, with router weights kept frozen. We analyze the implicit state-recovery equation and identify the convergence and replay conditions needed for reconstruction. On Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, the single-H800 evaluation reports 38.8 GB peak memory, versus 64.8 GB for supervised fine-tuning with checkpointing, and throughput of 25.1 versus 19.9 samples/s. DuplexTune achieves 67.2% MMLU, 75.6% GSM8K, and 7.69 MT-Bench, with a weaker multilingual score than the checkpointed baseline. The results characterize a configuration-dependent tradeoff among state storage, throughput, and adaptation quality.

translated_title: DuplexTune：面向内存高效混合专家模型适配的耦合状态重放
translated_abstract: 稀疏专家执行并不能消除适配混合专家语言模型所需的存储状态。我们提出DuplexTune，一个通过预训练注意力模块和专家模块重放耦合隐藏状态的框架。可训练的宽度桥接将两个残差流连接到主干网络。桥接预热先于主干网络适配进行，同时路由器权重保持冻结。我们分析了隐式状态恢复方程，并确定了重建所需的收敛与重放条件。在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B上的单块H800评估显示，峰值内存为38.8 GB，而采用检查点机制的监督微调需要64.8 GB，吞吐量分别为25.1与19.9样本/秒。DuplexTune在MMLU上达到67.2%，GSM8K上达到75.6%，MT-Bench得分为7.69，但其多语言得分低于使用检查点机制的基线。这些结果刻画了状态存储、吞吐量与适配质量之间依赖于配置的权衡关系。
tldr: DuplexTune通过耦合隐藏状态重放框架，在单块H800上以38.8 GB峰值内存适配Qwen1.5-MoE模型，较检查点微调降低约40%内存并提升吞吐量，任务性能相当，但在多语言能力上存在一定权衡。
